name: Rita Johnson, NTP
blurb: Rita Johnson runs Health and Hormones, home of the Health and Hormones Podcast, where she and her guests spend hours chasing one question: what is actually causing this. Ten-plus years into a nutritional therapy practice built on gut health and hormone balance, she treats root cause as the whole job.

name: Ginny Noce, RN
blurb: Ginny founded The Women's Health RN after her own hormonal imbalance sent her through years of dead ends that most members recognize instantly. A nurse and FEMM instructor, she blends clinical experience, functional nutrition, and cycle charting into one practice, teaching women to read their own bodies as reliable clinical data.
